questions.question: What is the output of `System.out.println(10 / 3)`?
questions.explanation: Integer division truncates the fractional part, so 10/3 = 3.

questions.question: Java supports multiple inheritance of classes.
questions.explanation: Java supports single inheritance for classes but multiple inheritance for interfaces.

questions.question: The keyword used to create an object in Java is ____
questions.explanation: The 'new' keyword allocates memory and returns a reference to the new object.
